user.description: How should the unit be found?

not_found.description: No unit that is not set up already answered the search. The search reaches units on the same network as Home Assistant.

pick.description: Choose the unit, and give it a name. The password is in Duka's app.

data_description.device_id: The unit's device id, and its IP address.
data_description.name: What the unit and its entities are called.
data_description.password: 1111 unless it was changed in Duka's app.

manual.description: The device id and password are in Duka's app. Leave the device id empty to ask the unit for it.

data_description.name: What the unit and its entities are called.
data_description.host: The unit's IP address on your network.
data_description.device_id: The 16 characters Duka's app shows for the unit; leave it empty to ask the unit.
data_description.password: 1111 unless it was changed in Duka's app.

reconfigure.description: Change where the unit is reached, or its password.

data_description.host: The unit's IP address on your network.
data_description.device_id: The 16 characters Duka's app shows for the unit.
data_description.password: 1111 unless it was changed in Duka's app.

error.cannot_connect: The unit did not answer. Check its address, device id and password: a unit does not answer a wrong password.
error.unsupported_device: The unit answered, but not as a Duka One does.
error.device_id_not_found: No unit answered at this address with its device id. Enter the device id from Duka's app.

abort.already_configured: This unit is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: The unit at this address has another device id than the one set up.

write_refused.message: The unit did not take the value.
